sources.title: Zambia Department of Immigration: Nationals Who Do Not Require Visa
sources.officialityEvidence: This is current country-by-country entry-category guidance from Zambia's Department of Immigration.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals of listed countries do not require visas; the list uses the legacy label Serbia and Montenegro.

sources.title: Zambia Department of Immigration: Nationals requiring visas on arrival or from Zambian Missions Abroad
sources.officialityEvidence: This is current Department of Immigration guidance defining nationalities eligible for a port-of-entry visa.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Listed nationals can get visas on arrival at any port of entry or from selected Zambian missions.

sources.title: Zambia Department of Immigration: Nationals Requiring Visa Prior to Travel
sources.officialityEvidence: This is current Department of Immigration guidance on nationalities requiring advance visa clearance.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Applicants must apply through the Director General of Immigration before arrival and receive an approval letter before travel.
